title: Drafts and Versions: Change Content Without Losing the Live Page | Orchard Core
description:
Editing a page that is live on your site should not change what visitors see until you decide. Orchard Core keeps the published version of a content item while you work on a draft of it.

This video shows how a content item keeps a published version and a draft, how to save a draft, preview it, publish it, discard it or unpublish a page, and how to find the drafts that wait on your site.

In this video:
• Drafts and versions: published and draft, the badges of the Content Items list, and the Draftable and Versionable settings
• Save a draft: edit a published page without changing the site, and preview the draft
• Publish or discard the draft: Publish Draft and Discard Draft in the Actions menu
• Unpublish a page: take a page off the site without deleting it, and publish it again
• Find the drafts: the Only draft items filter
• Permissions and older versions: who can save, publish, discard and unpublish, and where older versions go
